tips.text: Mod a mid-tier weapon such as a Hek, Rubico or Vectis; players who fail are on unmodded starter weapons.
Pour damage into Zanuka once Alad's shields are down; it is easiest to hit when it rushes over to revive him.
Use Trinity's Well of Life to lock Zanuka down, or Nyx's Chaos to keep it away while Alad bleeds out.
Do not knock Zanuka off the catwalks; Alad is unkillable until it respawns.
Abort and rerun if Alad gets stuck in a wall.
Take the free kill if Alad's health bar is already on screen at mission start; he and Zanuka are frozen in a T-pose.
Solo the fight once before being carried so you learn the shield and Zanuka order.
Switch to the normal Circuit during week 5 if Systems will not drop.
Start each component as it drops so the 12-hour timers overlap.
Nobody complains about base Valkyr; Neuroptics and Chassis come in a couple of runs, Systems in a handful more.
